sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
At the heart of Dark Space lies a simple yet engaging gameplay mechanic. Players control a spaceship that must navigate through a procedurally generated level, collecting resources and avoiding obstacles along the way. The game's controls are simple, with players using the mouse or keyboard to move their spaceship and the arrow keys to adjust its speed. As players progress through the game, the obstacles and challenges become increasingly difficult, requiring players to think strategically and make quick decisions to stay ahead of the competition. One of the key mechanics in Dark Space is the resource collection system. Players can collect resources such as gold, silver, and diamonds, which can be used to upgrade their spaceship's speed, health, and other attributes. The resource collection system is based on a timer, with players having a set amount of time to collect as many resources as possible. The game's difficulty level increases as players progress, with obstacles such as asteroids, space debris, and alien creatures becoming more frequent and challenging to avoid. Players must also be mindful of their spaceship's speed and health, as running out of either can result in a game over.

In addition to the resource collection system, Dark Space also features a unique leveling up system. As players collect resources and progress through the game, they earn experience points that allow them to level up their spaceship. Leveling up provides players with new upgrades and attributes, such as increased speed and health, as well as access to new ships and abilities. The leveling up system is tied to a progression tree, with players being able to upgrade their spaceship in various ways, such as increasing its speed, health, or firepower. The game's progression system is designed to encourage players to play multiple sessions, as each level up brings new challenges and opportunities for growth.

The game's core mechanics are well-designed and engaging, making it a joy to play Dark Space. The game's simplicity and accessibility make it easy for new players to jump in and start playing, while the increasing difficulty level and challenging obstacles provide a fun and engaging experience for experienced players. With its unique resource collection system and leveling up mechanics, Dark Space is a game that will keep you coming back for more.
